<script defer src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Staylow-flow/lowtideflow-assets@d59dd0e/js/ltf-btn-gradient.js"></script>
<script>
(function(){
  function wrap(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.ltf-btn-primary,.ltf-nav-btn-contact,.ltf-nav-btn-quote').forEach(function(b){
      if(b.closest('.ltf-btn-gradient-wrap'))return;
      var s=document.createElement('span'); s.className='ltf-btn-gradient-wrap';
      b.parentNode.insertBefore(s,b); s.appendChild(b);
    });
  }
  document.readyState==='loading'?document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',wrap):wrap();
})();
</script>
